recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-paneled composition featuring a central horizontal band of stylized, primitive figures against a dark background, framed by stark white space and a vertical informational sidebar (obi strip) containing dense typographic metadata.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the textured, hand-drawn central figures and the clean, geometric layout of the surrounding white space.
Vertical dominance of the left-hand sidebar against the horizontal orientation of the central artwork.
Rhythmic spacing of the four distinct anthropomorphic figures across the dark canvas.
coreInvariants: A central black horizontal rectangle containing four distinct colored figures.
A white border framing the central image.
A vertical dark sidebar on the left containing multiple levels of text hierarchy.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The primary artwork is a horizontal strip centered vertically, occupying approximately 50% of the total height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, red stencil-style title at the top center acts as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top title, moves down to the central figures, then scans the vertical sidebar on the left for technical details.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space at the top and bottom creates a clean, clinical frame for the expressive central art.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: White and Black provide the structural framework.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Red is used for the primary title to command immediate attention.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted earth tones (ochre, dusty blue, pale yellow, lavender) define the central figures.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between the black background and the light-valued figures; low saturation for the figures themselves to maintain a weathered look.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to primary red, black, white, and four distinct muted pastel-earth tones.

letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses thick, blocky stencil forms with visible gaps.
Secondary text uses high-contrast, clean sans-serif fonts.
Metadata uses monospaced or narrow gothic styles.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' in the main title is a simple triangle with a crossbar.
The 'E' has three equal horizontal bars without a vertical connector on the right.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-impact stencil display paired with utilitarian, dense technical sans-serifs.
graphicDevices: Black rectangular boxes for text containment

preserve: Stencil gaps in the main title
The horizontal band for the artwork

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, blocky feel of the main title.
Appropriate for the dense metadata in the sidebar.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a horizontal black rectangle centered on a white square. Inside the black rectangle, place four primitive, cave-painting style figures in a row: a four-legged animal in ochre, a dancing humanoid in blue, a crouching monkey-like figure in yellow, and a standing jackal-headed figure in lavender. The figures should have a chalky, screen-printed texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large red stencil-style title in a black box at the top center. Add a vertical black bar on the far left edge. Populate the sidebar and the white space with technical metadata and secondary titles using a mix of bold and condensed sans-serif fonts, ensuring a clean, grid-based alignment.

verificationChecks: Is the central art band horizontal and centered?
Does the main title use a red stencil font inside a black box?
Is there a distinct vertical sidebar on the left?
Is the color palette limited to the specified muted tones and primary red?

adjustableVariables: Texture level of the central artwork

mustAchieve: A clean, Swiss-influenced layout for the text
A hand-made, primitive feel for the central illustrations
High contrast between the graphic elements and the white background
avoid: Cluttered or overlapping text and imagery

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the stencil gaps in the title are clearly visible.
Check that the figures do not look like modern cartoons but like ancient petroglyphs.
Verify the vertical alignment of the left sidebar text.
Confirm the white space is clean and free of artifacts.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Primitive/Tribal Illustration] in a [Horizontal Band] with [Swiss/Modernist Typography] and a [Vertical Metadata Sidebar] using a [Red, Black, and White] primary palette.
